config.canonicalSubset: literals, identifiers, let/const/var, assignments, arithmetic, comparisons, logical, function calls, return, if/else, for, while, functions, basic TS types

functions.name: isNegative
functions.tsCanon: function isNegative(n) { return n < 0; }

functions.name: isEmpty
functions.tsCanon: function isEmpty(s) { return s.length == 0; }

functions.name: clamp
functions.tsCanon: function clamp(value, min, max) { if (value max) { return max; } return value; }

functions.name: add
functions.tsCanon: function add(a, b) { return a + b; }

functions.name: multiply
functions.tsCanon: function multiply(a, b) { return a * b; }

functions.name: abs
functions.tsCanon: function abs(n) { if (n < 0) { return -n; } return n; }

functions.name: factorial
functions.tsCanon: function factorial(n) { if (n <= 1) { return 1; } return n * factorial(n - 1); }

functions.name: fibonacci
functions.tsCanon: function fibonacci(n) { if (n <= 0) { return 0; } if (n == 1) { return 1; } return fibonacci(n - 1) + fibonacci(n - 2); }

functions.name: repeat
functions.tsCanon: function repeat(s, n) { let result = ""; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { result = result + s; } return result; }

functions.name: reverse
functions.tsCanon: function reverse(s) { let result = ""; for (let i = s.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) { result = result + s[i]; } return result; }

functions.name: capitalize
functions.tsCanon: function capitalize(s) { if (s.length == 0) { return s; } return s[0].toUpperCase() + s.slice(1); }

functions.name: truncate
functions.tsCanon: function truncate(s, max) { if (s.length <= max) { return s; } return s.slice(0, max) + "..."; }

functions.name: isPalindrome
functions.tsCanon: function isPalindrome(s) { let left = 0; let right = s.length - 1; while (left < right) { if (s[left] != s[right]) { return false; } left++; right--; } return true; }
functions.linBody: let left = 0;let right = s.length - 1;#(;left < right;){?(s[left] !== s[right]){^false};left++;right--};^true

functions.name: sum
functions.tsCanon: function sum(arr: number[]) { let total = 0; for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) { total = total + arr[i]; } return total; }

functions.name: findMax
functions.tsCanon: function findMax(arr: number[]) { let max = arr[0]; for (let i = 1; i max) { max = arr[i]; } } return max; }
functions.linBody: let max = arr[0];#(let i = 1;i max;){max=arr[i]};} return max

functions.name: count
functions.tsCanon: function count(arr: number[], target) { let n = 0; for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) { if (arr[i] == target) { n++; } } return n; }

functions.name: classify
functions.tsCanon: function classify(score) { if (score >= 90) { return "A"; } else if (score >= 80) { return "B"; } else if (score >= 70) { return "C"; } else if (score >= 60) { return "D"; } else { return "F"; } }

functions.name: dayOfWeek
functions.tsCanon: function dayOfWeek(n) { if (n == 0) { return "Sun"; } else if (n == 1) { return "Mon"; } else if (n == 2) { return "Tue"; } else if (n == 3) { return "Wed"; } else if (n == 4) { return "Thu"; } else if (n == 5) { return "Fri"; } else { return "Sat"; } }

functions.name: absFloor
functions.tsCanon: function absFloor(n) { if (n < 0) { return Math.ceil(n) || 0; } return Math.floor(n); }

functions.name: padStart
functions.tsCanon: function padStart(s, target, fill) { while (s.length < target) { s = fill + s; } return s; }

functions.name: debounce
functions.tsCanon: function debounce(fn, wait) { let timeout = null; return function(this, ...args: any[]) { if (timeout) { clearTimeout(timeout); } timeout = setTimeout(() => { fn.apply(this, args); }, wait); }; }
functions.linBody: let timeout = null;^function(this, ...args: any[]) { if (timeout) { clearTimeout(timeout); } timeout = setTimeout(() => { fn.apply(this, args); }, wait); }

functions.name: memoize
functions.tsCanon: function memoize(fn) { const cache = {}; return function(this, ...args: any[]) { const key = JSON.stringify(args); if (key in cache) { return cache[key]; } const result = fn.apply(this, args); cache[key] = result; return result; }; }
